title: 015 每个人都是两面派-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    晏梨看着王学灵那张脸，一时之间有些恍惚。

    她从前也遇到过像王学灵这样的人，她喜欢穿黑色的哥特风的小裙子，身上总是带着叮当作响的骷髅配饰。

    穿得像是阴暗角落里发霉的蘑菇，但却热情洋溢得像是赤道上四十度的大太阳。

    那时候还没有7856，她就是他们这些战斗人员的电子技术支持。

    她牺牲的时候，就像是如今的王学灵，脸上满是血污，却笑着露出了白白的牙齿。

    那一年她也是十七八岁，同眼前的即将高考的少年一般大。

    没人知道她叫什么名字，晏梨也只知道她代号乌鸦。

    晏梨想着，伸手揽住了王学灵的腰，以免他顺着洋流飘走了。

    她回稳了心神，再一次振动了一下翅膀，仔细的估算着速度，适应着身体新的变化。

    她可不能再来一次“撞壁”了。

    毕竟谁知道下一次会不会不受控制的撞上敌人的刀枪。

    王学灵被晏梨拽着，兴奋的张望着，捂住了自己的嘴，好快的速度！

    像坐过山车一样，他怕自己一个没有忍住，叫出声来。

    晏梨试了几次，待彻底熟悉掌握之后，方才停了下来，再回头一看，白色水母战车已经离他们有一段距离了。

    “梨姐，你是警察或者军人吧？你会用枪，在华国只有军警或者是歹徒，才会使用热武器。”

    晏梨正准备带着王学灵回去，就听到他突然小小声的凑到她耳边说道。

    她神色未变，看向了王学灵。

    少年这会儿脸色没有了兴奋，那双清澈又愚蠢的眼睛里带了几分落寞。

    “我妈妈就是警察，所以我能感觉到，你肯定也是。我知道我说这话厚颜无耻，可是我不知道可以拜托谁，如果可以的话，你能带宋班长回家吗？”

    晏梨平静地问道，“你喜欢宋子涵？”

    王学灵脸微微有些泛红，“她很优秀，长得好看，学习好，性格也好，我们班十个男孩有九个喜欢她。”

    他说着，垂了垂眸，“我也很喜欢她，但我不会告诉她。”

    别说现在他只剩下了一半，就算他是完整无缺的，他也不会向宋子涵说明心意。

    她那样的人，会走到更好的地方，她也应该，在更好的地方。

    “我不知道你接下来有什么计划，可我也看过小说。这可是末日，副本里到处都是危险，我们迟早会出现伤亡的情况，如果必须要有人死的话，请毫不犹豫的把我放在第一个，把她放在最后一个。”

    晏梨没有想到王学灵会说这样的话。

    明明他之前还是那样大大咧咧，没心没肺的样子。

Yan Li looked at Wang Xueling's face and felt a little dazed for a moment.

She has met people like Wang Xueling before. She likes to wear black gothic-style skirts and always has jingling skull accessories on her body.

He is dressed like a moldy mushroom in a dark corner, but he is as enthusiastic as the 40-degree sun on the equator.

There was no 7856 at that time, and she was the electronic technical support for these combatants.

When she died, she was just like Wang Xueling today, her face was covered in blood, but she smiled and showed her white teeth.

She was also seventeen or eighteen that year, as old as the boy in front of her who was about to take the college entrance examination.

No one knows her name, and Yan Li only knows her code name: Crow.

Yan Li thought and put her arms around Wang Xueling's waist to prevent him from drifting away along the ocean current.

She regained her composure, flapped her wings again, carefully estimated her speed, and adapted to the new changes in her body.

She can’t “hit the wall” again.

After all, who knows if you will run into an enemy's sword and gun uncontrollably next time.

Wang Xueling was dragged by Yan Li, looking around excitedly, covering her mouth, so fast!

It was like riding a roller coaster. He was afraid that he wouldn't be able to hold it back and would scream.

Yan Li tried it several times. After he was completely familiar with it, he stopped. When he looked back, he saw that the white jellyfish chariot was already some distance away from them.

"Sister Li, are you a policeman or a soldier? You know how to use a gun. In China, only military policemen or gangsters can use thermal weapons."

Yan Li was about to take Wang Xueling back when she heard him suddenly whisper into her ear.

She looked at Wang Xueling without changing her expression.

The excitement on the young man's face was gone now, and there was a bit of loneliness in his clear and stupid eyes.

"My mother is a policeman, so I can feel it, and you must be too. I know I am shameless to say this, but I don't know who I can ask for help. If possible, can you take Monitor Song home?"

Yan Li asked calmly, "Do you like Song Zihan?"

Wang Xueling's face turned slightly red, "She is excellent, good-looking, good at studying, and has a good personality. Nine out of ten boys in our class like her."

He said, lowering his eyes, "I also like her very much, but I won't tell her."

"Don't say that he only has half of it left now. Even if he was intact, he would not explain his feelings to Song Zihan.

People like her will go to a better place, and she should also be in a better place.

"I don't know what your next plan is, but I have also read novels. This is the end of the world, and there are dangers everywhere in the dungeon. Sooner or later we will have casualties. If someone must die, please don't hesitate to put me first and her last."

Yan Li did not expect Wang Xueling to say such a thing.

“Obviously he was still so careless and heartless before.
